x: Middle distance talent is almost in abundance so with challengers like Hampshire,Jarvis, Alan Mead, Hammond, Wiseman, Brown, Yeo, Redwood and Satchell not very far behind, David cannot afford to flag in his efforts.
With Hampshire and Morrison making their first appearances of the season, and packing well in with David Cocks, Belgrave swept the board in the Boys event.
Also competed:- Morrison, Hampshire, Yeo, Startup, Rendle, Finn, Satchell, Sturgess, Crosbie, Pearce, Williams, Dawson.
Youths' Championship, held at Guildford on Jan 14th Belgrave finished a disappointing 6th. Although Hampshire (7th) and Fairclough (14th) ran well, the rest of the team were well below form.
Cyril Forey (a great prospect) was a comfortable winner of the Junior race with John Thresher third; and our Youth success was due to Hampshire and Fairclough being 2nd and 3rd.

Heck, Miller, Thresher, Moore and Johnston are but a few knocking on the door to 1st team honours. There are also those up-and-coming lads Cocks, Hampshire and Fairclough who will be dis-placing a few old-timers before long.
